merchant.name: Polkaswap Community Store
merchant.dispatchPolicy: Volunteers purchase sealed tea after payment and confirm shipping availability before dispatch. Contact support for dispatch estimates.
merchant.customsPolicy: We ship from Japan wherever Japan Post accepts this tea. Volunteers confirm postal coverage and complete the required customs and food-import paperwork before dispatch. Some destinations are served by surface mail. Import duties and taxes may be payable by the recipient. If we cannot ship your order, we refund it under the refund terms.
merchant.privacyPolicy: Delivery details and contact are encrypted in the private relay and sent to the private volunteer notification destination. The relay deletes these details 30 days after shipment or refund, or 24 hours after an unpaid quote expires. Notification inboxes and encrypted backups have separate retention; contact support about those copies or privacy requests. Chain payments remain public.
merchant.cancellationPolicy: If an order cannot be shipped, we refund the XOR received, including shipping, minus the SORA network fee for sending the refund. Your original payment’s network fee is non-refundable. Refunds go to the verified paying wallet. Contact support to cancel before dispatch; refund processing has no fixed deadline.
